title: NSGo game generated asset source (version 1)
description: AssetSource records the provenance, generation parameters, license, and approval of an asset generated through an MCP generator server. It is written beside the picked asset as <file>.source.yaml in deterministic YAML.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must equal AssetSourceVersion (1).

generator.description: Generator is the MCP generator server name that produced the asset, such as "pixel-gen" or "sfx-gen".

model.description: Model is the generator model identifier reported by the server, such as "pixflux-1".

prompt.description: Prompt is the text prompt sent to the generator.

seed.description: Seed is the random seed that produced this candidate, when reported by the generator.

references.description: References lists the project-relative asset or brief paths passed to the generator as references (for example "art/characters/slime.png", "brief.yaml#art").

license.description: License names the license under which the generated asset is used (for example "pixellab-commercial-1.2" or "CC0-1.0"); an empty or "unknown" license blocks release builds until resolved.

commercialUse.description: CommercialUse records whether the asset's license permits commercial use.

approvedBy.description: ApprovedBy names the person who picked and approved the generated candidate.
